steps.name: hill of waiting
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Juriring] in “Whispering Hill.”

steps.name: take a break
steps.objective: Talk to [Juriring] in “Hill of Whispers” and report the quest to [Martha] in “Devesis.”

lines.text: (Juriring approaches Adventurer, who is lying on the grass and looking at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I found it because it wasn't in town, Ling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juri ring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What are you doing here, Ling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just… I was thinking about it.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What do you think, Ling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… . Hmm, I don't know if it would be okay to talk to Juri Ling.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Iris says it's okay, Ling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you talk to Iris?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Are you coming here? ring? Uh, uhhh… .
(When Jurillin raises his head, a small light flows from somewhere and comes down to Adventurer forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This light... .
(In the place where the light has disappeared, a woman stands looking at Adventurer and Juri Ring with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… ?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There you are, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't something wrong?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's not like that. The restoration of the Great Wall has been completed to some extent, so we can take a breather for a while.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow, it's Iris. ring.
(Juriling goes next to Iris and rubs her body, and Iris strokes Juriring.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thanks for your help, Juri Ling.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Debesis' favorite Juri Ring was just doing his job. ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Iris, let’s eat together. ring. The chef's cooking is really delicious. ring.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry, Juri Ring. I have other things to do now.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Okay, Ling. It's a pity, but let's go together next time, Ling.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to say to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's probably about Daphne and Barbatos...?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is a request not from Iris but from the Holy Spirit. %s, you need to take a break.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rest? You know Iris. Daphne and Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll keep track of them for now. A lot of power has gathered between the two, and now we can't chase them down using normal methods.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will follow them beyond the great wall. %s, in the meantime, take a break.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I insist, you're going to force me to take a break, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Iris I will do as you wish.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, can you tell me what Daphne and Barbatos are doing now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: First of all, it seems like Daphne has stopped taking witches' lives since a while ago. I don't know if there was any change in my state of mind.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It feels like preparations for the end.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And Barbatos is preparing to go to the realm of the gods. I don't know where it is, but... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You'll be able to catch up in no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: In the meantime, I'm taking a little rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I have a question.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if… If Hecate disappears at the hands of Daphne, what will happen to the witches?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Daphne believes that the problem will end once the cause is removed. Even though I know that the results may be different from what I believed... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There is nothing I can do without knowing what Hecate is thinking... . Still, I'll try to do everything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll take some rest. Call me back when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. wait for me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I won't make you wait too long. Well then, let’s go now. See you next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, be careful.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Hello Iris. ring.
(Iris greets everyone and disappears with the approaching light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel somewhat frustrated...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, it's almost time to eat. ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it too early? He ate with Patelo and it seems like he eats often.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: … Ooh, really? ring?
(Jurilin quietly looks at his stomach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Juri Ring… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you would tell me about Barbatos, who was Caulini, when the time comes. When was that?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm not sure. ring. Maybe when I come back after a good rest. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I come back after a good rest... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think I should just sit still… How is Medea? Should I go to Cali…?)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oops, I forgot Marta was looking for it. ring. Come on, let’s go. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Martha? okay. let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm...what's going on?)

steps.name: One memory I forgot
steps.objective: Talk to [Martha] in “Thebesis” and report the quest to [Medea] in “Kali”.

lines.text: (Marta is placing her hands on the structure in front of her with her eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The world inside this structure called Rikimo Felke... It won't be open anymore... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's me, Martha.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you were looking for me.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Yes. I had something to talk about, so I asked Juri Ling to find out where it was.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: But where did Juri Ling go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I said I was hungry and went straight to the ‘Cloud Threshold’.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I guess Lacellis will be busy as Patelo also went to eat. Patelo is already asking me when I can go up to the tower... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: When I said I didn't know yet, I felt sorry for them leaving in disappointment, so I wanted to... . I hope Lascellis doesn't hate Patelo too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Martha, should I go to Glaston and find out?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. Don't worry, I've already sent someone to look into it.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Since there are people with connections, I think I can get some answers.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: What I called today is... I heard you asked Mr. Patel about the legend about beastmen the other day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The legendary beast went up to the 'Blind Bird's Nest' during the chaos of the sky, and probably met God there.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The people of Devesis know, and this is the end of what I told Mr. Patel... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: There is one more thing I saw 25 years ago when I ran away from a spirit... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The moment the glass wall broke and I felt like I had returned to my original world, I encountered old memories that had been there... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I had forgotten about it for a long time, but it started to come back to me little by little as Rikimo Pelke disappeared.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The moment a beastman named Talos touches the large mirror... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Someone's image was reflected in the mirror.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it Belial?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: No. With rabbit ears… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember anything else besides that?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I wish I could say more, but that's all I saw. Like a fragment of memory... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Anyway, thank you, Martha.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The look on his face seems to have helped. Are you leaving Debesis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like that, I have a place to visit for a while. In the meantime, I'll take care of Elliot.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Don't worry. Schuvier is looking into it, and the others are also keeping an eye on it, so it should be okay.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: By the way, what happened to Elliot? He says he left Linford three years ago... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The road to Linford was cut off by an unknown force ten years ago... . Currently, part of the road from Whispering Hill to Aether Road is blocked by something like a powerful wall of magic.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The imperial family and council said they would try to overcome this situation through the Magic Agency and various religious denominations, but there was no success... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: As time passed, Linford was forgotten by people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Linford... It was definitely said to be the city of angels with a piece of heaven...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… . For now, I'll come back and listen to Elliot's story later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Martha, I will come back then.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Yes. Have a nice trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm going to Cali to rest, so Iris won't have anything to worry about.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something might be wrong... .

steps.name: a tumultuous reunion
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in “Kali” and go to where [Baynon] is. After speaking with Beynon, return to [Medea] and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … It was a nice day so I was going to have tea outside, but you came at the right time.
(Medea gently holds out the teacup to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Thank you, Medea. How have you been?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well, since I went to Lindos, I've been living well in the village with Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you're doing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, it smells good. It seems a bit different from what I drank before.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Io made tea bags by mixing flowers and herbs that only grow in Gerda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells good.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When I came to town before, I didn't know we would share tea like this... . You really can't know a person's future.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The day will come when the Kali people will no longer suffer in Eastland... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all thanks to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. What did I… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Isn't the hero who saved Eastland too humble? There are just a few I've seen... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Hilda… . When did you come?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I was bored so I took a short walk around the village. You know you can't go out yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, more than that, what and how did you see it? Since when did you know me?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hmm… . From the moment you came to Eastland? So to speak, it's long... . I don't even want to tell this long story.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: But what's going on in Kali? It's not like I came because I wanted to see you... . Well, it must be because of Daphne, right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, sit down. Would you like some tea?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes, I want to drink it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, what happened after you broke up with us?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was work... . I went to a place called Nidaros in Alfheim... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Hilda and Medea briefly what happened from Nidaros to Thebesis.)
(The faces of the two people listening to the story harden little by little.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to come in a good mood, but I'm sorry for telling you this, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No. Rather, thank you for telling me. I have a feeling that it was no coincidence that you came to Cali... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it's Daphne, it's possible. ha.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s… . You might want to hear the proper answer to that question... . Even I don't know.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don’t think witches will be freed from that life just because Hecate, who gave them the life of a witch, disappears at the hands of Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In the worst case scenario, the rules of the world itself may change... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The best way would be for Hecate to change her mind, but that is very unlikely... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even Daphne won't change her mind... . In the end, I guess I have no choice but to face it... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The 'thing' that will be completed soon will help stop Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stuff?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Remember what I took from Dmitri earlier? In Lindos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you would leave it to Glinda, right?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I went and visited with Medea not long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is that item? How can I use it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It'll take a little longer, but it won't take long. So, can you wait a little while in Cali?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why does it feel like the town is shaking? no way… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: An old man is coming.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s… . Excuse me, would you mind bringing him over while we prepare dinner?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Shinik, you are here.
(Baynon looks at the little girl who fell to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: At first they helped me up, but now they just leave me alone. Sheesh, not fun.
(Baynon stands Shinik up and dusts him off.)

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: As I always say, if you do this, you will be in trouble... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's the problem? It's not like I come to Kali Village once or twice.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Aren't there more than one barrier that was broken by rushing in without controlling one's magical power?!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sorry♡

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You are quick to apologize... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I told him to quickly admit that Medea was wrong.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea, you’re making excuses here… . Chisa, no, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baynon, I will take Shinik with me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, it’s been a while♡
(As soon as Shinik sees Adventurer, he runs into his arms and hugs him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s been a while, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: In the meantime, I haven't even come to play. Would it be fun if you left me and went to another continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When others hear it, they misunderstand it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought I was going to die of boredom♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's good to see you alive.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: %s… , A lot has changed in the meantime. To deal with Shinik so tauntingly... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right. When you first came to meet me, you were so scared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, it was like that back then.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Ah, time... . %s, please take care of Shinik. I have to go on patrol to Adrica... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like Beynon has changed a bit too.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Is that so? I'm glad you felt that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you happy?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yeah, thank goodness. Well then, Shinik, have a good time and go back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Bye, see you next time♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go too?

steps.name: It's no fun if you go alone
steps.objective: Talk to [Martha] in “Devesis” and report the quest to [Shainic] in “Outskirts of Avalon.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Does the food suit your taste?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, it's delicious.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry for making you come like this every time. I was planning to go to Tartarus to see Noel... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay. There was a situation. Kali is not far from Tartarus, I just have to run like this♡

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I mean the old man.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is it, kid?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The old man seems to have a really good relationship with Medea. When you first came to Eastland, the superhumans didn't get along very well.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's all an old story. But you! Medea is Medea, so why am I an old man?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Shinik is older than Medea.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Can I look after the little boy's hand? I won't kill you. I'll do just enough so I don't die♡
(As Shinik smiles coldly at Hilda, a chilling energy comes over the once peaceful Kali.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, are you going to just say that and say nothing more? Hilda, don't provoke Shinik like that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although you are both my valued guests, I will not remain silent if you cause trouble in Kali Village... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You two, you knew, right?
(Medea smiles and looks alternately at Hilda and Shinik.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Media, you’re angry….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. okay.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry, old man.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How about an older sister instead of an older person?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: They're not even my blood relatives. I'll just call you by name.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Hilda, are you okay today?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I didn't get Medea's help today, but it's better than I thought.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you two have the same soul texture, right? In fact, it wouldn't be surprising if anyone fell apart... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: In the past, there were many people who died and went to the underworld for that reason.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although it was an unwanted ability, I'm glad it was helpful to Hilda.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Media… … .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, I'm okay.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But where is the minuet? I don't think I've seen it these days.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At some point, I think I was able to escape Adrica. So, he said he was traveling around the continent with the feeling of traveling.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris Adkina told me that he felt bad for Minuet walking barefoot and gave him shoes as a gift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see you are doing well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad you're doing well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have a favor to ask of Shineek... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just say it. I will listen to everything except death♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then, could you please get me something called the ‘Jewel of Unity’?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jewel of solidarity? What is that?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a rare item that has been found all over Eastland for a long time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It got its name because it was used to strengthen places made of magical power.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thanks to Shinik, there are no longer any Bond Jewels left. ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Can't I help in my own way, other than the Jewel of Solidarity?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That… Because of Daphne, I have to personally use the Jewel of Binding to reopen the barrier. It seems difficult any other way... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All you need is a Binding Gem.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll save you. How many do you need?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Just one is enough.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The demon beasts hide it well, so if you scold them, they will take it out on their own.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Shinik?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Let's go together. It's no fun if you go alone. Aren't you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go with you, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. That's right♡ Let's go, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I can't help it. Since it's been a while since I've been to Eastland, I'm going with Shinik.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I came here to rest, but it's a shame I can't rest... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Originally, I was planning on leaving it to Shinick only... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. You can go quickly and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, then where do we go?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Although it is fierce and ugly, it is a ranch full of cute demon beasts. It's a place you might like too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are demonic beasts… Ranch?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's really fun ♡ Are you going to sleep in?

steps.name: Let’s punish the demon beasts ♡
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Shiinic] at “Outskirts of Avalon” and enter “Camelot Ranch”. 
2. Defeat [Captain Camelot] at “Camelot Ranch” and obtain the <Jewel of Unity>. Then go outside and report the quest to [Shinic] in “Outskirts of Avalon.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's what's happening in Freios. And it's amazing that you solved all of that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. What I did was just… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I know. It's all for the beginner goddess and everyone else. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shynick seems a little different from before.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's why I'm doing something annoying, okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. But those clothes… . It feels like I'm seeing this for the first time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Did you finally find out? How about it, pretty? This is an outfit commissioned by Chrysien.
(Shaynik spreads his arms and moves them around in front of %s as if to look at the new clothes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so pretty. It feels similar to the old clothes, but seems lighter. It somehow looks like a school uniform.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah? I guess he wanted to make me feel better because I never went to school.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: While I was making clothes, Medea also tried to make clothes in this style, but I was hurt because she looked at me with a straight face.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: His expression hardened as if he was someone I would never see again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because everyone has different tastes.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea is tall, so cool clothes look better on her.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, I heard that this cute style suits me only, so it's okay♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Oh, that thing on your back... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You know this, it's my friend's stuff. I want to keep remembering it, so I’m leaving it like this. Pretty, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought about keeping it in my mind, but I didn't want to do that. If possible, it's always better to be together.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, it's not that difficult.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thank you, %s. You know how I feel, right? If you don't know, you might kill me♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course I know. Uh, is there something strange over there?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Doesn’t it look strange to you too? From there is the ranch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is a place in Avalon where flowers and trees grow so luxuriantly... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Welcome to my ‘Camelot Ranch’ full of demons♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. ‘My’ Camelot Ranch? Shinik’s ranch?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Didn't I tell you? I am the ranch owner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know that Shinik likes cute things, but I didn't know that he was in charge of the Demon Beasts' Ranch.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even though it is part of Avalon, which is polluted, clean, unpolluted grass and trees grow well here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All the grass and trees transplanted from other places died, but those transplanted near this ranch survived.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I think it has something to do with demonic beasts, but I'm not sure yet. So I decided to do some more research. I have a lot of time anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think the demon beasts will listen well, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, it's okay. Because I'm having as much fun as they've had ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If I tell you I'm here again today, there will be a revolt. Last time was probably the 145th... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, today’s episode 146 will be fun too. Let’s get scolded together♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . You were counting them all... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Shinik, will you be able to find the Jewel of Unity soon?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The reason the fanatics of the Deimos Church brought in and raised demonic beasts was to use them for attack purposes, but it was also to find such things.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I discovered some good things in the 48th, 91st, and 138th rebellions. It wasn't a bonding gem, but I found something useful and used it to rebuild Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I think the probability of finding it is low... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, don't worry. I'm sure this time. A while ago, I saw something that the captain had hidden so preciously.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I left it there so I could take it next time. Let's go and get it. It'll be fun♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, you're sure to have fun... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehehe. Let's hurry. It's very fun to suppress the 146th rebellion caused by demonic beasts♡
(As you follow Shinik to the road that appears to be the entrance to the ranch, a different scenery unfolds from Avalon, where you stayed for a while.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the land connected to Avalon... It's fascinating. In general, it seems like a peaceful ranch that people know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Unpolluted green bushes, beautifully growing flowers and trees, and rolling around on them… animal?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. They are magical beasts.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The magical beast lying over there is ‘Camelot’. It looks amazing, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Something black with the expression of a cat is covered in capybara skin. At first I thought there was something strange like this, but when I looked at it, I found it cute.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't know how the fanatics brought it from the demon world, but I think they wanted to use it to attack people or protect Avalon.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It seems like life here is more comfortable than in the demon world, so all you have to do is eat, sleep, and lie around, so the fanatics have almost given up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But these guys are rebelling?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Do you know the habits of demonic beasts? You are completely loyal to the strong.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There is a leader. That guy is inciting the demon beasts here and they are continuing to rebel. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You have to praise at least one piece of grit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … There's more to it than Camelot.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text:
The cute demon beast over there is ‘Surikata’. 
It resembles an animal called a meerkat that lives in the desert, and it was also brought over from the demon world by fanatics.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I managed to bring it too.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, there are many ways. They also had no interest in anything but playing with Camelot.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But when he saw me scolding the Camelot people, he suddenly put on some armor and attacked me with a weapon.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So I played with him a lot and he became calm♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's that flying over there? Freeling?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's a weed ring. It was a freeling that originally lived nearby, but after eating the food left behind by Camelot and Suricata, it turned into a living herb. You've been transformed into a demonic beast.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Can you see the leaves on the head of that weed ring? If you eat that, your magical powers or curses will be amplified, or you may become immune to certain symptoms. It also has skin regeneration, synthesis, and recovery effects.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Unless you're going to make it into medicine, it's delicious if you wash it well and eat it with meat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is that really okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I already called a guy who likes meat and finished the experiment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Baldrick….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The kids in front of here are calm. I scolded him so much that he now listens to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means the demonic beasts over there... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now it looks like they are preparing to start the 146th rebellion. If we cross the line here, they'll come in at breakneck speed.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now, %s. Let's make a bet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bet?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The first person to find and defeat Captain Camelot and take the Jewel of Binding wins. Let's assume that the loser dies♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then I go first!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Shinik! Shinik!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's gone. Phew, I can't die like this... . Let's go find Captain Camelot.
(Adventurer takes down the charging demons for a while and then looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, there are so many demons. How many of them are there? . I think I've visited all the places I can go, but I can't even see Captain Camelot's nose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what is that?
(Adventurer's eyes rest on what looks like a small, worn-out bed that looks like a large animal sat on it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking at the size, it doesn't seem to be something used by Little Camelot. Is this something from Captain Camelot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… . There's something sparkling over there... .
(Just then, a large shadow appears behind Adventurer.)
(Adventurer tries to step back quickly, but is caught by the hand of a large shadow and lifted upside down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Captain Camelot… ?
(Adventurer makes eye contact with a bizarre black beast with a cat's expression inside a large capybara snout.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can't you let go of this? Wow, what kind of power is this strong?
(Even if Adventurer struggles, Captain Camelot doesn't care and just shakes it. Then, he taps it with his other hand and opens his mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you really going to eat it?
(At Adventurer’s words, the expression that was unclear as to what he was thinking changes into a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t want to be eaten like this!!
(With those words, Adventurer, caught in Captain Camelot's hand, recoils powerfully and stabs Captain Camelot in the eye with both powerful feet.)
Boom.
(Captain Camelot drops Adventurer and covers his eyes with both hands in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it the body that was in the mouth? .
(Captain Camelot rubs his eyes, looks at Adventurer, and lets out a roar mixed with the sound of metal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, that's a lot of power. I keep getting pushed back just by roaring... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I should take the opportunity and go out with the jewels. uh?
(Captain Camelot draws an X with both hands and shakes his head left and right.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No?
(Captain Camelot nods, making an O shape with both hands. He then clenches his hands and raises them towards Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to fight.
(When Adventurer raises his weapon, the ranch's demons come running as if they were waiting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, it's annoying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's give it a try.
Boom.
(Captain Camelot loses his balance and falls backwards due to the shock of being attacked by %s.)
(He tries to get up again and run over, but is startled by %s's hand gesture and flinches. Then he sits down and lies down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?
(At the words of Adventurer, Captain Camelot takes out a small white flag from within his arms and waves it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you admit defeat? No more fighting, right?
(Captain Camelot puts his hands together and prays and pretends to cry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe they won't attack you from behind like this...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I take the jewels now?
(Instead of answering, Captain Camelot picks up an old bed and shakes it up, and several sparkling jewels fall out of it.)
(Captain Camelot picks up the jewel and presents it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, it certainly doesn't seem like there's any hostility...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. Then eat this at least.
(Adventurer takes out some Luman beef jerky from his pocket, puts it in Captain Camelot's mouth, and scratches his stomach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let’s check it out… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think it's this blue gem, but this rabbit-shaped purple gem... . no way… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right.
(Captain Camelot is startled by the sudden appearance of Shinik, drops the beef jerky he was holding and slowly retreats.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Captain Camelot, I look forward to the 147th rebellion♡
(Captain Camelot trembles all over, grabs the beef jerky, and hurries away somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehehe, it was fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: To see how good you were, I told another demon at the entrance that my subordinate would be going this time, and he excitedly prepared for the 146th rebellion.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Camelot is a beast that is difficult to tame, and it hurts their pride to be tamed by someone. At some point, such demonic beasts are unable to overcome their anger and end up killing themselves... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Damage it moderately and then bring it back to life, that's how it should be. For now, until all the flowers and trees here are properly transplanted to Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Although it means well, it feels strange somehow.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's okay because I'm not playing against the devil♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this gem, you said it as if what I had guessed was correct.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. That was made by the rabbit witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't be alarmed, let's go outside first. Isn’t it a hassle to deal with the demonic beasts again?

steps.name: I have to go back quickly
steps.objective: Talk to [Shainic] in “Outskirts of Avalon” and report the quest to [Medea] in “Kali”.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Do you want to hear a story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think that's the story to talk about here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Since this is a story related to the rabbit witch, it would be better to hear it from Medea, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's do that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, is it okay if I leave the ranch like this? I think the only thing I did when I came was scold the demon beast... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay. Don't worry♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Captain Camelot is angry that the rebellion has failed, so he gathers demonic beasts again and plots the 147th rebellion.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The demon beasts are simpler than I thought, so they don't know that this is my intention. Anyway, it will be like this until the Avalon purification is over♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even the meat idiot told me to come here sometimes to relieve stress, so I guess it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At this point, I feel sorry for the demon beasts...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Let's go to Cali. Medea will wait.

steps.name: steps towards hometown
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in “Kali” and report the quest to [Shainic] in “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's almost time for you two to come.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I want to go and check it out too... . It still won’t work, right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, please wait here. It's still dangerous outside. I'm not familiar with that place, so I'll go and get it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So will that be the end?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I hope it ends.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There was a time when we thought the suffering that had gripped this continent would never end.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But the moment I met everyone and went out, I began to believe and hope that it would all end... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I believe this time too... I hope everyone's suffering will end.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah, I understand.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There are two people coming over there.
(Shaynic extends his small arm towards Medea, shakes it with all his might, then runs at high speed and hugs her.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I went♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We went there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad you came back safely.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's where you need to be afraid of the witches on the ranch. Ah, what I saw before was a little different... . It really came as if it was going to swallow everything... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll stop talking about old times. Here's a gem of solidarity. Take it. Is this enough, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, this will do. Thank you, Shinik. It's been so long since I've seen this gem... . Phew, it's shaped like a rabbit... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Something feels off... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hilda, even if you hate Daphne, don't hate the rabbit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because rabbits are innocent.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes, but… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, please explain to %s why this gem is shaped like a rabbit. I guess you're curious.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see. So let me tell you about this gem. It's not a big story, but... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A long time ago, the Kali people, like this place now, spread multiple layers of barriers to block outsiders from entering the area to prevent it from being exposed to the outside world.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This purple gem imbued with magical power serves to strengthen the barrier, but it seems to be unable to assimilate into the Kali tribe's barrier and always breaks.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As if the power of the gem alone was not enough, Daphne extracted my magical energy to strengthen the Jewel of Binding. At that time, I had some idea and carved it into the shape of a rabbit. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thanks to this, the village of Kali was safe for a while, but the peace did not last long... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There must be only one bonding gem in the shape of a rabbit... . This is how it came into my hands.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I want to believe that your feelings for your family are genuine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it intentional…? .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Jewelry is a means to establish a barrier, nothing more or less, so I don't want to worry about it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Anyway, I'll set up the barrier again. This will make you stronger than before. There will be no more breakages caused by Shinik running towards you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, okay♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But next time, just walk in normally.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, how do you create a barrier with this gem?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: While the two of you were at the ranch, the barrier technique was reconstructed and spread throughout the village.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now, if I just do this, I'll be done.
(Medea throws the binding jewel into the hole she had previously dug, covers it with dirt, buries it, and taps it with a staff.)
(Then purple magic rises and surrounds the entire Kali village.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I feel the will to protect the village... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, cool. As expected, it was a good thing I went.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There is something I would like you to help Medea with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, if there is something to help, you should help. But what happened?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You remember being separated from Dmitri the Twisted One in the Shrine of Lindos, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you were making something like a sphere.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We've created a black sphere like this, but it needs to be more perfect.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You shouldn't create that situation, but you'll need it the moment Daphne tries to harm Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it take to make it perfect?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I guess I'll have to go there too to find out. It's a place I never wanted to go to again... I'm planning to go tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Where was the old Kali village?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that's right. This is ‘Mistwood’, the hometown of the Kali people.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Do you remember the way to go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No… . Now I have no memory of that time... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hilda is not allowed to go out, and %s doesn't seem to know the way to go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There is a good way♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: take me away I know the way. Then I must go to Tartarus and prepare.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, come to Tartarus with Medea tomorrow morning. I'll be waiting for you♡ Medea, make sure to wear those clothes. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik? Shinik?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait a minute, Shinick. Just wait and see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's gone... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … It's like Shinik.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought Shinik would know the way, but I never thought we would go together like this... . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, then, please take care of me tomorrow. Let’s take a rest in the village today and go together tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea. I'm glad I could help.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mistwood, where Kali Village used to be... I wonder what kind of place it is. Since I'm going there anyway, I'll find out when I go...)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let’s finish everything and go back… . To where I belong... .

steps.name: Like going out to play
steps.objective: Talk to [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus” and report the quest to [Xena] in “Zisk Territory.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvik, I’ll be back soon. Medea will be here soon.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, where are you going? And Medea is coming?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Didn't I tell you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes. You didn't do it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I wanted to go to the place where the Kali tribe's old village was.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It must have been a village before the Kali people came to Adrika. I once heard this from Mr. Noel.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea has some homework left, so I'm going to help her. It'll be fun, right?♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I don't know if it's fun, but I hope Shinik will be of help to Mediah as well.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Medea, like Shinik, is my benefactor.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehehe, Melvik. You've grown a lot. I know how to say things like that.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, you seem to forget sometimes, but I am already an adult.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I know. Then, grow up as much as you can.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: As expected, Shinik, thank you. Hey, Medea is coming. It looks like Noel brought you from the entrance to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Medea, I'm so glad you came to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Noel, I'm sorry. I have work to do today, so I won't be able to see Noel for a long time.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's okay. By the way, did Medea have clothes like this? I feel like something is a little disappointing... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: These are the clothes I gave you as a gift.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: As expected, Shinik! Because you know how to look at clothes. I like Medea’s style, so she wears clothes like this. Wow, it's pretty.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Right? Pretty, right? Wait here for a moment. I'll change my clothes and come out♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since I saw Noel, and he's grown a lot in that time.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: There is no choice if you want to make a living, hehe. How have you been, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was fine. Noel, how are you?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's nice that it's easier to get around Eastland these days and business is doing well. I also collected some Ellie. There is still a long way to go before opening a store.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … It's great.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thanks to Mediah, Shinik, and %s. Hehehe. Well then, have a good time. I'll just go now.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I will also step down. Noel, look at me for a moment. There is something I want to get through Mr. Noel... .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Mr. Melvik, really? I'm happy. Then come this way. Quickly, quickly.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Noel has also grown a lot. I was worried a lot when I went out of town, but I'm okay now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I'm working hard towards my dream.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, you waited, right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry, because of me... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No, no. I do it because I like it. I just want to help.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The closest road from here to there is in Jisk's territory. It'll be near the lake. Come on, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it by the lake? Can I meet someone nearby?

steps.name: The road to the foggy forest
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Xena] in 「Jisk Territory」 and use the portal to 「Mistwood」. 
2. After all conversations are over, enter 「Mistwood」, kill [Weed Ring A], [Suricata Knight], and [Busy Camelot], and report the quest to [Medea] in 「Mistwood」.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Are these the lyrics right? Hmm, ah, ah… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The memory of falling into the lake will not remain forever♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I want to reach out and capture it, but it flows away and never comes back♩

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: If you want to go back, all you have to do is remember that time♪
Clap clap!
(Jenna steps back in surprise at the sound of applause coming from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I was surprised. It felt like a ghost had appeared somewhere... . Oh, I was a ghost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, it’s been a while.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How are you, Jenna?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It’s been a while for both Adventurer and Mediah. I am always well. But is that Shinik?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Jiscard's younger brother?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's right. He's that guy's younger brother.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: They look a lot alike.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: But how did you three end up here? I don’t think this is normal… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I came to visit the place where the Kali village was located a long time ago. There will be a path leading up from here.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Have you been to the estate before? That's the road to Mistwood.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When Ixion was using me as a weapon, I think he went around the Jisk territory and went near it, saying he was going to kill the fanatics of the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's okay because it's an old story. Even the bad guys are gone.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Well, if you don’t mind, I’d like to ask you one question… . Could it be that your going there has something to do with him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe a witch… ?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: If you're talking about the rabbit witch, no. He was a person who resembled Gaia.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You saw the minuet. Previously, he was an incarnation of Gaia, but now he has been blessed and travels the continent at his own will... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm a little uneasy because he has a blank expression on his face as if he's possessed by something.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Jenna says she doesn't know, but Minuet always has a blank expression on her face.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems like he just crossed the territory and went that way. Nothing much will happen to the minuet. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Jenna, we are going because we have business to do, regardless of the minuet. So don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, I understand… . So are you leaving right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since I last saw you, and I'm sorry I have to go so soon.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's okay. I'm glad to see it like this. Instead, can I just see you off in front of Mistwood?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Even if you can't go far, you can still get there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Jenna, thank you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Everyone please follow me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This is the border between the territory and Mistwood.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you go straight ahead, it's Mistwood... . Yeah, I remember.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Then I will go back. Everyone, take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: See you next time, Jenna.
(As soon as Jenna waves her hand and says hello, she disappears as if evaporating on the spot.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: As expected, he returns like a ghost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Suddenly, I thought of old times... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A long time ago, there was a beautifully shining forest here... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's probably over there... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: At that time, Ixion said that there was a village somewhere here where a mysterious clan called 'Kali' lived.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The old man also wanted Kali's power, but couldn't find it. My magical power was gradually depleting.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … As I became stronger with that human's weapon, I continued to eat away at that human's magical power... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I felt magic coming from somewhere in Mistwood, but I just kept my mouth shut.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If that old man had found the Kali people back then, I would have died too. Because there would be no need for it anymore.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: And we wouldn't have been able to meet.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Phew, shall we stop talking about old times? After going to a certain point... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … Medea, can you feel it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's where Kali Village used to be... I think there's something there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … yes… . It definitely has the feel of an old village, but there's something strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you see it over there? The demon beasts of Camelot Ranch are here, what are they?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don’t think it’s because of the ranch demons… , I have a feeling there is something waiting for us.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's clear that all the escaped kids are here... .
(As Shaynic lifts the Death Scythe he was carrying on his shoulder with both hands, Medea also strengthens the hand holding the staff.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then, let’s give them a proper welcome ♡ If possible, even scold our ranch’s magicians!

steps.name: A past trapped in a curse
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Medea] in 「Mistwood」 and enter 「Silent Spiral」. 
2. Defeat [Spiral Minuet] in 「Spiral of Silence」 and obtain <Void Stone>. And be sure to go out through the reward room and report the quest to [Medea] in “Mistwood.”

lines.text: (After chasing the demon beasts that escaped from Camelot Ranch for a while, they arrived at a place where Medea saw a large pillar of light unfolding before her eyes and sat down on the spot.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… . It just reminded me of some old memories... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I guess it's because it's been so long... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I could have come before, but why did I come now? .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I came too late... .
(Mediah closes her eyes and quietly lifts her wand, feeling the fluctuating pillar of light.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we take a short break and talk before we go in? If you have any questions, please ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although it is now a barren land, long ago this place was always a misty forest.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: People from outside came in, drawn by the mysterious atmosphere as if the forest had been swallowed by fog, but most of them got lost.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Those who had wandered into the same place and barely escaped called it a mysterious forest, ‘Mistwood’, and rarely approached it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, there was a village of the Kali clan in this forest. Even then, the name of the village was ‘Kali’… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A place loved and cherished by the Kali people... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought I would never come here again... . After all, you don’t know anything about people… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew, I guess it's inevitable that my emotions will be agitated... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It brings back a lot of memories. I don't know which of them are my own memories, but... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems like I was very happy before I left here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As a child, I ran around the forest path with my friends, and the adults set up signposts here and there to prevent the children from wandering down the path.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In the evening, the children went home, and I, led by another adult, ate and fell asleep.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then one day, the fog cleared and darkness came... . As you might guess, in that darkness there was a man who led them along with the fanatics of the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. At his gesture, people's screams filled the forest. I was confused and didn't know what to do... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We end up talking about things like this. I guess I trust you a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Media….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think there was a similar expression in Freios. You can think of it as a magical vortex, something like that... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A pillar made of numerous lines of light... . At some point, I saw that line. No one except me and Daphne could see it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I asked him what it was, but he ignored it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I didn't think it was a big deal either, but at some point, the line began to show in the eyes of the villagers.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then one day, the line erased the fog that had enveloped the village of Kali. As a result, fanatics from the Deimos Church targeting the Kali clan invaded the village.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: On that day when painful screams filled the forest, that person made a choice to save his family... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He pulled the lines of light, tore them into pieces and spread them through the air, and the village was surrounded by the space created by those lines.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The fanatic who touched that line screamed and melted, but that wasn't the end. The line literally trapped part of the village.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although this pillar of light is only visible to us now, it is made up of many lines of light. There is a road between those lines.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A space filled with silence in a twisted spiral... The so-called ‘spiral of silence’… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is what we're looking for? Then, you have to go into that line of light... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Media… This is... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please tell me… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That line of light... . A force more powerful than a cartwheel is at work.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Although I accidentally broke through the Great Wall, the Wheel is still a place where people related to God, including superhumans, can come and go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But this one looks like it was made by dragging part of the great wall. It's on a different level... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That was hundreds of years ago... Did Daphne draw on the power of God and use it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Recently, at Hilda's request, I was convinced as I purified a fragment from the Twisted One.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That he is a being capable of handling this kind of power... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And that there are objects related to gods somewhere in the old Kali village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that thing in Cali?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Maybe he needed it to turn me into a perfect witch... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, sniff. It stinks. I definitely feel something. I have to go find it quickly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I quickly find it and complete it. Can I just go in there like this?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There used to be no way to get in there. But now it is possible.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Because the little girl is stronger than she was then.
(When Medea raises her staff, the pillar of light that appears to be the ‘spiral of silence’ fluctuates.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Create a gap by splitting the tightly tied lines with Shinic and Death Side.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah.
(Shinyk jumps up from his spot and swings Death Scythe towards the pillar of light. Then, the pillar of light splits slightly, revealing a gap.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … It's about to close again. It won't happen all at once.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll keep shaking it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We will continue to hold on to this pillar of light and keep it from closing. Someone has to keep looking for it. Please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, it’s the hometown I wanted to come back to so much. Let's go together and get that item.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll do something. Don’t worry and go♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mediah, let’s trust Shinik.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, thank you. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just trust me♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.
(The two people leave Shinik behind and jump into the split line of light.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Perse, can you open the gate to the underworld for a moment? To use some strength.
(At that moment, a black sphere filled with magic flowing from somewhere appears above Shinik's head.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So where should I try to hack away?♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… . %s, cover your mouth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea.
(When Medea raises her staff and hits the floor, the darkness surrounding her recedes.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … It'll be okay now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .
(Adventurer's gaze moves busily to capture the image of the world within the gap.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is the old Kali village… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It looks like it's cursed, no, it looks cursed... . Trapped in a spiraling vortex of magical power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s similar to the current Kali village, but it’s also very different… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well, except there are strange plants growing there... .
Media… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this voice?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No way… … .
Medea? long time no see… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, do you know whose voice it is?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: These are village people who stayed with me a long time ago. These people are no longer in this world... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don't listen... . This is an auditory hallucination created by a demon who attacked the forest with fanatics of the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's clear even though it's been a while since I heard it.
Medea, why are you here now? You waited.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Daphne's choice allowed half of Kali Village's residents to survive. We couldn't save the rest... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The surviving residents did not blame Daphne for creating a spiral of silence and disappearing. Instead, he felt sorry for me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They must have known. That I had always looked the same for a long time, trying to become the perfect witch in Daphne's hands.
Medea, let’s play together. Daphne locked you up again?
Media, do you want to try this bread? You were hungry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I feel anxious in situations like this... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The people of Cali didn't hate me... . On the contrary, it gave me strength... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He asked me to sacrifice himself to save the young villagers... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: From the moment I received their power, I became a superhuman who realized some of the power of God in Eastland. And some of the witch powers planted by Daphne were awakened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I used to hate my situation, but now I've accepted it all.
Save me, Medea. We're going to die like this... ?
Medea, it's because of you. We're going to die because of you.
Because of you, the Kali people were attacked... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since I keep hearing auditory hallucinations, it seems like demons are also trapped here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to be careful... . Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It would have collapsed in the past, but not now. Hehe, would you like to look over there first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lines in the sky are fluctuating... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think maybe something is going on out there somewhere.
Media… Save me... .
Daphne abandoned us and ran away... . I don't want to die... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Foolish devils… .
(When Medea raises her staff and stretches it towards the sky, the demons that were hidden by something are revealed.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As we go to the end, the demons that have been tormenting me and the residents in this way will appear... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I feel reassured. Then, please.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: From auditory hallucinations to visions... . The devil is still creating the worst... .
(Medea strikes the head of the last remaining demon with her staff. Then, with an ugly sound, the struggling demon struggles and evaporates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As always, it feels bad to deal with these demons and beasts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, I think I went around the old Kali village... We can't see what we're looking for.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's something over there.
(Someone slowly appears in the direction of Mediah’s gaze.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia?
(The moment Adventurer tries to approach, Medea holds his hand and stops him.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No… . Gaia was asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you awake again?
(The moment a person who looks like Gaia approaches, Medea is startled and steps back slightly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet… ?
(As the being whose name was called looks at the two people, the space everyone was in begins to shake.)
(Minuet, who feels as if Gaia has become corrupted, raises her hands to the sky while praying, a large plant stem extends out and attacks the two people.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet, stop!
(The light flowing from the tip of Mediah's staff repels Minuet's attack.)
(However, the minuet continues to create swirls of light as if it has no intention of stopping.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, is there any way to stop Minuet?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, listen carefully. Now there is only one way to return the minuet to its original state. That would be best in this situation... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must suppress that power with our own strength. That way, you can get the minuet and find the item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, there's nothing we can do.
(Adventurer makes eye contact with Minuet, who does not feel any emotion, and quietly strengthens the hand holding the weapon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, I'm sorry. Just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 나선의 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ouch!
(With the scream of a minuet, the surrounding thorn vines that had been rising as if alive shattered like shards of glass and fell to the floor.)
(Then the black shadow surrounding the minuet becomes blurred.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now! Strike this light with as much force as before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes!
(When %s's weapon hits the transparent light created by Mediah, it splits into several pieces and flows to the suffering Minuet.)
(The light covers Minuet's head and erases his dark appearance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?
(The black shadow completely disappears, and Minuet, with all the bad energy gone, collapses into a cold sweat and sits down in place.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Woof… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wake up, Minuet!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Media… sir?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Why are you two here... ? What was I doing here?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You don't remember anything at all?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I ended up here during my travels, but I think I lost my mind at some point... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Did this call me... ?
(Minuet takes something out of her arms and shows it to Medea and %s. Things like beads in a bottle are shining softly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Who would have guessed that it was this product that made the minuet like this... . ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, please explain to me about this item. Is this what we are looking for?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that's right... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I feel nostalgic for some reason... . This is from the ancient gods... … .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's no wonder that Minuet, the incarnation of Gaia, reacted to this object.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I had forgotten all along... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was Daphne going to do with this object?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: … Is there a Shinik nearby?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We came together. He's helping us from the outside to get us in here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you know that?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It seems like he is using the power of the underworld... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … ah… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That won't work. Let’s get out quickly. I'll talk more about it outside.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet, can you do it?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is a shortcut to the place you came in from here. Follow me!

steps.name: determination not to forget
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in “Mistwood” and report the quest to [Medea] in “Kali”.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet, hold on tight.
(Medea pulls the minuet that is not coming out properly.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Whoa… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Who is this? Minuet, hello♡
(Shainik wipes the sweat from his forehead and catches the minuet, which is about to fall. Then he looks at the closed line of light again and smiles broadly.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's over. thank god… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Huh? Am I supposed to not be okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it... Why did you use the power of the underworld?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How did you know? I tried to use it secretly... . Uh, did you say minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I felt like I was in pain... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't have enough strength with just the strength I have♡ Anyway, I'm glad everyone came out safely.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, I'm fine. are you okay. It's okay because I only use it once in a while. It won't crash like it used to.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don’t do that again… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, I'll be careful. right. I guess it came out because I found that item, right?
(Medea holds up the item she found in front of Shinik, who is curious.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This is the item Hilda said she found. It looks amazing... … . for a moment… this… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll tell you all here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This object is what Daphne called the 'Void Stone'... . It is a bead that has been refined from some of the power extracted from the remains of an ancient god... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know where I got this, but I know what I'm going to use it for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You see, I was destined to become a perfect witch by his hands. To do that, strong strength was needed.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In the worst case scenario, he could have become a created god... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No way, just like Atalanta….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … Crazy rabbit witch!! You tried to use this on Medea... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinick, it didn't happen. Calm your excitement.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But… okay.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Daphne's plan went awry when fanatics from the Deimos Church attacked the village.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Anyway, I don't know if Daphne still needs the Void Stone, but for us, it has become a necessary material for the future battle.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because of that power, it was no wonder that the minuet was influenced and became that way.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It looked as if Gaia had been corrupted and was running wild.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Sorry... . I didn't do that on purpose... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Minuet, are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Woof… … .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, the dazed feeling is the same as usual.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, just be careful and bring this item to Hilda... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, what are we going to do here now? Even if the line of light becomes slightly faint, it doesn't seem to disappear completely... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This will be my past, present, and future. For the rest of my life, I will continue to look for ways to save this place... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Great job, Medea. It's the best thing I've heard recently♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a question: since when did minuet become free from adrica?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I was able to leave Adrica when I realized that I wanted to truly feel what life is... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I think Gaia gave it to me as a gift... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I will part ways here… . There are many places I haven't been to yet, so I'm thinking of going somewhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, is it okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Something like this has happened, so you should be careful with the minuet.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If it's not okay, you have to make it okay. Minuet, if you make an accident, I will scold you so much that you will ask Gaia for forgiveness♡

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'll be careful... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Then… I'll go. See you later… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Minuet.
(Minuet waves lightly in greeting and then walks towards somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The minuet has definitely changed a lot from before... . As if we have changed... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sure… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we go back now? Hilda will wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Let's go.

steps.name: A future where the fog has cleared
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, and then go to [Baynon] in 「Kali」. When the situation is over, return to [Medea] in “Kali” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Here… .
(Medea hands a bottle containing a glowing bead into Hilda’s waiting hand.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This will do. But where is Shinik?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merrymel was captured because he wanted to be taught.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm not sure, but it seems like Shinik is kind to Kali women... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now how can I use it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's urgent... . %s. Look at this.
(Hilda puts the black sphere in her hand into a bottle containing beads and seals it.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Soon the stone will dissolve and seep into the black sphere. Here, take it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can't use it right now, but it will be helpful in some way when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… no.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Both Mediah and %s have a lot of things they want to ask me, but I know they are holding back.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you want to hear my story, let's deal with the bad guys first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah. It'll all be done when it's all done... . me too… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda? What did you say just now?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I didn't say anything... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Come to think of it, %s, you haven't had a proper rest since you came here. Get some rest. You don't know what will happen or how.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry, %s. Since I came to Cali and couldn't rest properly, so you helped me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, it looks like there are people gathered at the entrance to the village... . What's going on? It's noisy. Who came?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, I'm sorry. I'll hide for a moment.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes? why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought it would be a little annoying... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry. It'll just take a moment. I'll be in town.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, it just disappeared. Where did you go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We'll hear Hilda's story later, but let's go first... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Merrymel, weren’t you with Shinick just a little while ago?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: He ran to Tartarus, saying there was something I needed and that he would bring it to me.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Merrymel, wait a minute. fizzle. Come here.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Huh? why?
(Baynon steps in front of Merrymel and aims his bow at the approaching person.)
Hello, Kali people.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: All, dark elves... … ?
I am neither a strange person nor a dangerous elf. Calm down.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: … Among those who say that, there is no one who is not strange or dangerous.
Not at all. What a wonderful elf I am. Cute and sweet Kali girls are a must-know!

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Just stop there. Don't come closer. If you take even one step, this arrow will pierce your heart.
You're being rude... . yes. All right.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Answer the question. Where did you come from... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: What is Dockalp?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Meriel, why are you interrupting me... .
