Ah, I guess I should explain. On the Continent of Freios, dark elves are also called dorkalfs.
However, they are not bad elves, as they follow darkness rather than evil. I guess I was just a bad elf in Eastland.
I apologize on behalf of all elves. The beautiful young elf priest will apologize to you, so please accept it.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: How did you know about Cali Village? I don't think he's an ordinary person, but his identity is revealed... .
As expected, you have amazing eyes. As you can see, I am not an ordinary person.
I am Askren, a priest belonging to the Immortal Priests of the famous Hodmis Church on the Continent of Freios, a group of elite priests.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'm not bragging, but I became the youngest level 5 priest. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: It's a long story. What happened to that?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: … This is so amazing! To become a level 5 at this age, you have to go through a lot of hard work! (crying)
(At that moment, the eerie day of Deathside approaches Askren's neck.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Aaaah, Sa, please save me!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What are you?♡

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Huh? Ooooh, this is the famous Shinick's Death Side that I've only heard about.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Shinik, I will solve it. Step back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It sounds like fun, so I'd like to hear the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Priest Askren?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, do you know how much I've missed you? You just left Freios and are now in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You are truly new!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: … He's a tiring person to deal with. Anyone who knows Adventurer will leave at this point.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, do you know someone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … He is the priest who helped me when something happened in Nidaros.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see. Nice to meet you. My name is Medea from Kali Village.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Wow, this is how I meet Medea and Shinik, whom I had only heard about.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: That's the church's secret record... . Oops, sorry. I tried to keep it a secret, but I couldn't. Please think of it as fate and welcome it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You look fun too♡

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Rather than being funny, wasn't he rather handsome?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: It's hard to deal with... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hey, it's not fun.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The priest is suspicious, but I will listen to the story from the Demigod behind him.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There, Demigod, don't hide, come down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demigod? Frozen is here?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Frozen was very busy, so he missed this project... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This incident…?)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Instead, someone else came.
(As Askren points his finger to the sky, someone who was looking down from a high tree gently lands.)
The view of Kali village was so good that I was watching it from above. Nice to meet you all.
(A woman flips her long pink hair, makes eye contact with a bright smile, and extends her hand to shake %s's hand.)
I'm Lydia. And the spirit on my shoulder is Roro. Greetings, Roro.
(Demigod Lydia strokes the head of the spirit introduced as Roro. Then Roro blinks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you…

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: The Lydia that everyone you've ever met has talked about. One of the three Demigods. By the way, there are now two people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. I am %s… no see. I never thought we would meet like this.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I didn't expect to be greeted like this either, but something urgent came up and I came to Cali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Seeing Demigod come in person like this... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merrymel, Beynon, I will take them with you. You two, finish what you were doing.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Merrymel, here's your new tool. Take it.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Aaaah, Shinik, I love you.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then, Lydia and the priest, please come this way.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth happened... Demigod Lydia and Priest Askren came...?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Would you like to have a cup of tea and talk?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I'm curious about the cars in Kali Village, but I'll hold off for a moment because I need to tell %s what we're here for first.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Let's do that.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Are you nervous?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like you're holding back for something.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Pink demigod, is this fun?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There are many interesting things we do at the church.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Priest Askren, shut up and take out what you have prepared.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, I understand. here… .
(Askren takes out a small slate from his pocket and holds it out in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this? It looks like my name is engraved on it... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Iris This is a stone slab made from the divine stone that was in the space where you recovered after returning from the darkness.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: If a person's name appears on this stone tablet, I will find that person and check the contents.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you came to see me... . So what should I check?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: This is a stone tablet whose contents can only be confirmed by the person to whom the oracle has been placed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An oracle?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris said… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: What you think is correct. As a star god, he gave his first oracle to %s.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: A message sent in the name of God can be a command or a prophecy. So I need to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I'd like to talk to Iris... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: That's not possible. Even if you are mentally connected to Iris, you cannot do anything once the oracle has been given.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Whatever the contents of the oracle are, until it comes to an end... . That's the relationship between God and humans, but... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: You may not understand it now. Because it happened suddenly. But that’s what trusts are all about… . Anyway, do you trust Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: You know he won't make you feel bad.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Now, %s. Put your hands on this slate. Then you will naturally find out.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: And quietly recite what it means. Please do me a favor.
(Lydia quietly holds %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you please... all right.
(When Adventurer places his hand on the slate, an unknown vision of light and darkness unfolds before his eyes.)
(And then the image of a man standing in front of him appears, looking different from before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... ? No, Kaulini… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … … A person with the fate of a demon god... … It's waiting for you in 'Amaranth Nova', so stab it in the heart and destroy it... … ?
